events.title: SOPHIE BUDDELL (Friday)
events.description: Sophie Buddle is a stand-up, a TV writer, and a podcaster. She has just wrapped as the head monologue writer for “After Midnight with Taylor Tomlinson.” She has also appeared on “The Tonight Show”, “The Late Late Show with James Corden”, and on CBC’s “This Hour Has 22 Minutes as a correspondent and staff writer. She's also been featured on CTV’s "Roast Battle", JFL All Access, Kevin Hart's LOL Network, the Winnipeg Comedy Festival and the Halifax Comedy Festival. She was a featured performer at the Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in Montreal and in 2022 had the esteemed privilege of delivering the Canadian Keynote Address on Comedy. Why'd We Book It? Sophie is witty, self-depricating, and extremely candid. We were so excited to hear about her podcast, "Obsessed with Sophie Buddle", which has some of our favorite comics on as guests. Her and her guests will talk about her latest obsessions like smoking, Tiktok, and Nintendo switch - which we can all relate to. Her style stood out to us when she did The Late Late show with a joke about being cheated on, but don't worry she doesn't own a baseball bat. For Fans Of... Taylor Tomlinson, Iliza Schlesinger, Nicole Byer Extended Bio: Sophie released her first album in 2019, "Lil Bit Of Buddle," which won the 2020 Juno Award for Best Comedy Album of the Year, making her the first female comic to win that award. She released the album herself so you can find it on iTunes in the genre "easy listening", which was a mistake, but it is easy to listen to, so it's OK. Her podcast "Obsessed with Sophie Buddle", which tackles people’s obsessions (from Beyoncé to American politics to checking if the door is locked to revenge) is currently available on Apple Podcasts. She is a three-time runner up (but fourth time’s the charm!) for Canada's biggest stand-up contest, SiriusXM Top Comic, and can currently be seen headlining across the country. Seating/Show Information: This show will have theater seating. Seats will be assigned upon arrival, or can be chosen ahead of time for an additional fee. QR Code Ordering will be available for this performance. Doors open at 5pm. Don't miss our famous Bottlerocket Pre-Show Clip Collection, beginning one hour before the start of the performance. This show is ALL AGES *all information subject to change as needed. Bottlerocket FAQ: All shows starting before 10pm are all ages unless otherwise noted. Free parking is available at 824 Industry Street and 205 Allen Street, as well as other public lots in the area. Live Music shows have limited seating options, please arrive early or reach out to the venue directly if you know that you require a seat. Doors open at 5pm for all shows unless noted otherwise. The time listed on the ticket is the event's true start time. Most shows have a preshow experience starting 1 hour before the show. Our full refund policy can be viewed here Please contact us ahead of time with any accesibilty requests or concerns, we're happy to accomodate you. More FAQ's can be found here

events.title: Chat Pile
events.description: Chat Pile is an Oklahoma City noise-rock and sludge-metal band known for abrasive guitars, heavy rhythms, and stark examinations of social violence and decay. The group broke through with God’s Country (2022), a widely acclaimed debut that includes “Slaughterhouse” and “Why,” then expanded its sound on Cool World (2024). Chat Pile’s name references toxic mining-waste piles in northeastern Oklahoma, a fitting emblem for music that combines industrial weight, confrontational vocals, and bleak, sharply observed songwriting.

events.title: G. Clanton: Mainstream Now Tour
events.description:
George Clanton
w/ support from Ryan Hemsworth

⚡️ FRI NOVEMBER 6TH ⚡️
~spirit hall~

• tickets on sale tomorrow (8/7) @ 10AM •

George Clanton doesn’t just produce gleaming electronic pop, he produces nostalgia too. The Los Angeles artist’s process involves tweaking synthesizer presets, but beyond searching for the right melodies and textures, he’s hoping to come upon a sound that strikes a spiritual chord. “I’m looking for something that triggers a memory or an emotion,” he says. His lyrics are direct transmissions from his soul: raw, often off-the-cuff, evocative. When you pair those words with the gauzy textures Clanton’s become known for, his music feels like a dreamy filter you can put over your own memories. Every moment feels a little more colorful, a little more comforting.

events.title: WesGhost
events.description: WesGhost is an emerging alternative artist known for pairing moody production, melodic vocals, and emotionally direct songwriting into a sound that moves between pop, rock, hip-hop, and dark electronic influences. His music often explores themes of heartbreak, isolation, ambition, and self-destruction, giving his songs a cinematic quality that feels both intimate and intense. Through streaming platforms and social media, WesGhost has developed a growing audience drawn to his atmospheric soundscapes, vulnerable lyrics, and visually distinctive artistic identity. Tracks across his catalog showcase a talent for combining catchy hooks with shadowy textures, allowing him to stand out within the modern wave of genre-blending alternative performers. As his fan base continues to expand, WesGhost is establishing himself as a compelling new voice for listeners who gravitate toward emotional storytelling, late-night energy, and music that blurs the line between vulnerability and edge.

events.title: Max Weinberg's Jukebox
events.description: Max Weinberg's Jukebox is a live concert experience led by legendary drummer Max Weinberg, best known for his longtime role with Bruce Springsteen's E Street Band. Unlike a traditional concert, the show allows audience members to help shape the setlist by requesting songs from an extensive catalog of classic rock favorites, creating a unique performance every night. Backed by a talented group of musicians, Weinberg delivers energetic renditions of iconic songs spanning multiple decades of rock history. Known for its interactive format, exceptional musicianship, and spontaneous atmosphere, Max Weinberg's Jukebox offers fans an engaging celebration of classic rock and live performance culture.

events.title: Sting 11/6/26
events.description: Sting is a legendary singer-songwriter, bassist, and performer known for blending rock, pop, jazz, reggae, and world music influences into a sophisticated and timeless sound. Rising to fame as the frontman of The Police before launching a successful solo career, Sting became celebrated for poetic lyrics, distinctive vocals, and musically adventurous songwriting. events.title: Beginner Woodturning: Holiday Ornaments with Matt Iannacci
events.description: Make your own ornament in time for the holiday season in this beginner-friendly workshop! 3-Hour Workshop Date: Saturday, November 7th, 2026 Time: 10am-1pm Description: In this workshop, students will learn how to create a hanging ball-and-icicle style holiday ornament using different woods to add color and texture. Great for both beginner and intermediate turners, students will learn the capabilities of spindle-orientation woodturning. Each student will walk away with at least one finished, polished ornament, ready to be displayed for the holidays! Time permitting, the instructor will also demonstrate how to turn a more advanced holiday tree-shaped ornament. Special thanks to Turners Anonymous for the use of lathes during this workshop! Tuition: $80 + $25 materials fee Materials: All materials will be provided. You will be working in a fully operational woodshop and we will go over all equipment safety precautions. Please arrive wearing closed toed shoes, no loose or baggy clothing, and long hair tied back. Location: Contemporary Craft Timmons Studios (5688 Butler St., Pittsburgh, PA 15201) Cancellations and Refunds: Workshop cancellations are decided three business days before the start date. If workshops must be cancelled due to insufficient enrollment, the entire class fee will be refunded by check, to your credit card, or Contemporary Craft account for future workshops. Refund Policy: Student refund requests must be made at least three business days before a class begins. There will be a $25 cancellation fee. No refunds will be given without three-business days notice. Processing of refunds takes approximately three weeks. If you require accessibility accommodations, please let us know by calling 412.261.7003 and we are happy to assist you. About the Artist “I have been woodturning for over 10 years, and doing wood flatwork for more than 7 years. I focus on medium-sized peices (vases, urns, etc., in woodturning, and jewelry boxes and frames in flatwork), usually seeking to combine different wood species to provide color and texture in my pieces. I am also the inventor of the JS3 jig, which is used to set up for compound-angle cuts necessary for splayed-stave woodturning, or boxes with leaning walls.” Outside of woodworking, Matt is a full-time mechanical engineer, a dad, and a saxophone and flute-player in a jazz band in the North Hills in Pittsburgh.

events.title: Basketry: French-Style Wine Basket with Traycee Bosle
events.description: Elevate your plaiting skills in this two-day workshop and create a wine basket just in time for holiday gatherings and gifting! Basketry: French-Style Wine Basket with Traycee Bosle two-day workshop Date: Saturdays November 7 and November 14 Time: 1:30 PM – 4:30 PM Description: Elevate your plaiting skills in this two-day workshop designed for students who have completed at least one basket-weaving class or who have some experiecne making a basket. Participants will explore next-level techniques, including weaving a solid basket floor, working with varying material widths, creating visual patterns with curls, and decorating a handle. Along the way, students will gain confidence in shaping and finishing more complex forms. The result is an elegant French-style wine basket that is both functional and beautiful. Size is 10 inches wide x 5 inches deep x 14 inches high. This workshop is part of our 2026 Gift Guide Suite of offerings! Make a gift to give someone special this holiday season, while giving yourself the gift of learning and camraderie in the studio! No refunds will be given without three-business days notice. Processing of refunds takes approximately three weeks. About the Artist Traycee Bosle is a professional basket weaver at Craftisinal Creative Works—her arts studio in Pittsburgh, PA. She is a member of the Handweavers Guild of America and the Fiber Arts Guild of Pittsburgh. With over 1500 works in several different weaving styles under her belt, you can find her work in homes across the U.S. Basketweaving is an ancient art that crosses nearly all time, geographic, political, and social boundaries. It’s rooted in history, mathematics and pattern, color theory and design—with so much to offer—yet it’s nearly a lost art. Traycee has made it her mission to share her love for this once ubiquitous and critical skill with people of all ages. Her classes are fun, informative and personalized! She provides hands-on, individualized instruction using her own specially designed basket kits to teach the fundamentals of the art and meet each student where they are in their skill level. Whether you are an absolute beginner or have already made a few baskets, you will walk away with new skills and a beautiful basket you can use every day.

events.title: Introduction to Weaving: Beginner Basics with Luca Budofsky
events.description: Weaving-curious? This workshop will introduce you to various types of looms, and will get you started weaving on a frame loom! Introduction to Weaving: Beginner Basics with Jamie Boyle 3-hour workshop Date: Saturday, November 7 Time: 2:00pm – 5:00pm Description: Curious about different kinds of looms? Want to try weaving but you are not sure where to start? Let this workshop be a beginning for you! Jamie will share some weaving basics and will guide you through weaving on a frame loom, which you will get to take home with you! Additionally, you will get to experience how some different types of looms function, including a rigid heddle loom and a multi-harness loom, guided by the general question: what does a loom do? In this class you will primarily work with your hands on a non-mechanical frame loom, but you will get an overview of various modes of weaving and get to try other looms in the studio! Tuition: $65 + $15 materials fee (if you are viewing this listing on your phone, scroll down to the bottom of the page for the class registration link) Materials: all materials are included. Registration: Register through Eventbrite! If you are viewing this listing via the Contemporary Craft website on your phone, please click this link to visit the Eventbrite registration page. Scholarships: We really want you to join us in the studio! Full and partial tuition scholarships are available—with some limitations—to alleviate some of the financial burden of attending a class. Scholarship application is found at this link . You can expect to hear from someone on the CC staff within 2 weeks. If you have any questions, email Jamie Boyle, Fibers Program Manager, at jboyle@contemporarycraft.org, or leave a voice message for them at 412-465-1628. Location: Contemporary Craft, TImmons Studios (5688 Butler St., Pittsburgh, PA 15201). Note, this workshop will take place in the Fleischner Family Fibers Loft, which is on the second floor of the building. There are 2 entrances to the Timmons Studios. • One entrance is facing Butler Street. To access the Fibers Loft from the Butler Street facing entrance, there are a total of 32 stairs to ascend. • One entrance is facing 57th Street. This entrance is accessible by ramp, with no stairs to ascend. There is a lift inside the building to access the Fibers Loft on the second floor. If there are accessibility accommodations we can provide, or if there is anything you would like us to know before you arrive, please feel free to call Jamie Boyle at 412-465-1628 or email jboyle@contemporarycraft.org. About the Artist Luca Budofsky is a multimedia artist from northern New Jersey. They hold a BFA from Carnegie Mellon University School of Art with a minor in Soft Technologies. They take particular interest in how textiles occupy shifting scales of material production and the way the woven structure breaks a surface into modular interlocking pieces. They love chance encounters with light casted on walls and sidewalks. They like noise. They think public radio is cool. They attribute their interest in cyclical events and repetitive processes to being a triplet. Luca has been recognized as an Andrew Carnegie Society Scholar and as a recipient of the Samuel Rosenberg Art Award. They work and weave in Pittsburgh, PA.

events.title: Ethan Regan with Lily Kershaw
events.description: Ethan Regan is an emerging singer-songwriter whose heartfelt lyricism and warm, acoustic-driven sound have quickly earned him a growing audience in the indie-folk and pop landscape. His music blends intimate storytelling with memorable melodies, drawing inspiration from personal experiences and themes of love, change, hope, and self-discovery. Regan's expressive vocal style and understated arrangements allow the emotional core of each song to shine, creating an authentic connection with listeners. Through a steady stream of original releases and live performances, he has developed a reputation for sincerity, thoughtful songwriting, and a refreshing musical approach that balances modern production with timeless singer-songwriter traditions. As his career continues to evolve, Ethan Regan is establishing himself as a promising new voice with the ability to turn everyday experiences into deeply resonant songs.Lily Kershaw is an acclaimed singer-songwriter known for her ethereal vocals, cinematic songwriting, and graceful blend of indie folk, dream pop, and contemporary acoustic music. Her songs often explore themes of vulnerability, relationships, personal growth, and quiet introspection, pairing poetic lyrics with elegant melodies and atmospheric production. Squirrel Flower, Merce Lemon, Neko Case, Wild Pink BIO: When I was recording what would become “Miss Obliteration” with Day Wave I started to get the eerie sense that I was writing more than lyrics, but predictive themes. I was married to my second husband but could see the writing on the wall, a metaphorical tornado was about to tear through my life I denied it. The record kept getting pushed back for various reasons, and I kept thinking it was getting pushed back by a greater force, now 3 years later my life is entirely different and I am radically changed as a person. events.title: Demi Adejuyigbe
events.description:
Join comedian, writer, and internet personality Demi Adejuyigbe for a night of stand-up comedy. Known for his viral September re-imagining music videos, his work as a writer on 'The Good Place' and 'The Late Show with Stephen Colbert,' and his popular podcast appearances, Demi brings his sharp wit and unique comedic style to the stage. Two shows will be held on November 8 at 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM.

DEMI ADEJUYIGBE returns to Bottlerocket with a is a brand-new hour of original jokes, songs and bits he has designed for the sole express purpose of abandoning his scruples and making as much money as humanly possible.

Demi made his Bottlerocket debut last year with the much heralded fringe favorite DEMI ADEJUYIGBE IS GOING TO DO ONE (1) BACKFLIP - now he returns which his follow up, also a fringe favorite from this August’s festival, DEMI ADEJUYIGBE SELLS OUT! Demi has long been one of our favorite people in comedy, and in recent years it feels like the world has finally caught up; as he’s seen his fanbase grow from Dropout to Letterboxd and beyond! If it’s like the rest of Demi’s work you can expect something deeply silly, full of archaic references and a touch of musical performance, ultimately landing somewhere much more profound experience than you may have expected. That’s what makes Demi so exciting, and that’s why we’re so excited to welcome him BACK to the Bottlerocket stage!

Through energetic live performances and a catalog filled with stylish, groove-driven songs, Donny Benét has established himself as one of the most unique and entertaining figures in modern independent music.

events.title: Mountain Grass Unit
events.description: Mountain Grass Unit is a fast-rising bluegrass ensemble that has earned attention for its impressive musicianship, youthful energy, and fresh approach to traditional American roots music. The band blends the foundational elements of bluegrass—lightning-fast picking, tight harmonies, and acoustic instrumentation—with influences drawn from jam bands, folk, and contemporary Americana, creating a sound that appeals to both longtime bluegrass fans and newer audiences. Known for dynamic live performances, the group frequently stretches songs into inventive improvisational passages while maintaining the precision and craftsmanship associated with classic bluegrass traditions. Their growing reputation on the festival circuit has been fueled by a commitment to authentic musicianship and a willingness to explore new creative directions within the genre. As they continue to build a national following, Mountain Grass Unit is helping introduce a new generation of listeners to the enduring appeal of acoustic string music while carving out a distinctive identity of its own.

events.title: SPANISH LOVE SONGS
events.description: SPANISH LOVE SONGS with support tba $20 ADV / $25 DOS 7PM DOORS / 8PM MUSIC ALL AGES for fans of... The Menzingers, The Wonder Years, The Hotelier The National Independent Venue Association (NIVA) announces the first-ever “Certified Live Independent Tour” featuring Los Angeles indie rock quintet Spanish Love Songs. The band’s 20-city tour will visit independent venues exclusively, marking the inaugural tour for the “Live Independent” certification program. NIVA developed the groundbreaking initiative to elevate and safeguard independent venues, promoters, and festivals nationwide. BIO: Over the last decade, SPANISH LOVE SONGS have watched a fiercely loyal community take shape one cramped club show and one new listener at a time. That momentum has carried the band to tours with The Wonder Years, Alkaline Trio and Hot Mulligan, along with appearances at Furnace Fest, 2000trees and the revived Vans Warped Tour, following the release of instant classics Schmaltz (2018), Brave Faces Everyone (2020) and No Joy (2023). This intimate, powerful connection with their audience is proof that even in an era defined by isolation, people are still out there yearning for others to stand beside them in the darkness. That search continues on FUTURE NAUSEA, the Pure Noise quintet's fourth LP. Drawing from the widescreen ambition of heartland rock – the anthemic sweep of records like Born in the U.S.A., Sam's Town and Full Moon Fever – shimmering synths, ringing guitars and soaring choruses define an expansive sound crafted across sessions with producers Chris Walla (Death Cab for Cutie) and Sarah Tudzin (Illuminati Hotties). Against that backdrop, Dylan Slocum's characteristically observational lyricism remains the band’s beating heart: deeply empathetic and unflinchingly honest as he chronicles political violence, climate anxiety, late-stage capitalism and the quiet ways these existential crises seep into everyday life – and, just as critically, how moments of love, companionship and shared resilience become the antidote to an increasingly uncertain future.

Plus, visit our sensory table and explore our Interactive Play Spaces, including a larger-than-life Draw Alive station. Sensory Bags from KultureCity, featuring items like headphones and fidget toys, are available to borrow daily at the National Aviary.A helpful sensory guide to the sights, sounds, and climate of the Aviary's habitats can be viewed in advance AND during your trip. Please register in advance!

events.description: Josh Gondelman is a writer and comedian who incubated in Boston before moving to New York City, where he currently lives and most recently worked as the head writer and an executive producer for Desus & Mero on Showtime. Previously, he spent five years at Last Week Tonight with John Oliver, first as a web producer and then as a staff writer where he earned four Emmy Awards, two Peabody Awards, and three WGA Awards. Josh also previously wrote for Fuse TV’s Billy On The Street. Why'd We Book It? Josh is an incledibly silly guy with a calm voice that brings all the wit and self deprication that makes you laugh. We love seeing him on Wait Wait... Don't Tell Me! - he is a hilarious panelist and it is always a treat when they have him. As fans, we also had a blast watching John Oliver and being able to pin point what jokes were written by Josh For Fans Of... Tommy Brennan, Caleb Hearon, Joe Pera Extended Bio: His most recent hour, Positive Reinforcement, is now available to stream. Josh’s debut standup special People Pleaser was released in 2022. In 2016, Josh made his late-night standup debut on Conan (TBS), and he has also performed on Late Night With Seth Meyers (NBC) and The Late Late Show with James Corden (CBS). Gondelman is the author of the essay collection Nice Try: Stories of Best Intentions and Mixed Results published September 2019 by Harper Perennial. Since 2019, he has been a regular panelist on NPR mainstay Wait Wait Don’t Tell Me. Offstage, Gondelman is also the co-author (along with Joe Berkowitz) of the book You Blew It, published October 2015 by Plume. His writing has also appeared in prestigious publications such as McSweeney’s Internet Tendency, New York Magazine, and The New Yorker. Seating/Show Information: This show will have theater seating. Admission is free; no reservation required.

events.title: Member Preview: Greer Lankton: "Could It Be Love"
events.description: Greer Lankton: Could It Be LoveCurated by Francis Schichtel and Jordan WeitzmanCould It Be Love presents an intimate and powerful photographic survey of Greer Lankton (1958–1996), the legendary East Village artist known for her uncannily lifelike dolls and fearless exploration of gender, beauty, and the body. Featuring 24 rarely seen photographs of her iconic dolls, taken by Lankton herself, this exhibition reveals her uncanny ability to imbue life into her sculpted figures as they lounge, gossip, and perform across New York’s gritty and gorgeous downtown scene.This exhibition celebrates Lankton not only as a trailblazing trans artist but also as a completely original image-maker whose lens captured a world of oddballs, queer icons, and doll-like doppelgängers with equal parts glamour, melancholy, and wit. Presented in partnership with Magic Hour Press, Could It Be Love follows the release of the first major monograph on Lankton’s photographic work.Discover the new exhibition, then mingle with fellow members over light refreshments in the lobby.Not a member yet? Support the museum today and gain access to special events all year long.Please note, parking is limited at our main lot at 505 Jacksonia Street, with additional street parking available in the surrounding neighborhood. About Greer LanktonGreer Lankton (1958 – 1996) was one of the most significant artists to have taken part in the revolutionary art scene of New York City’s East Village during the 1980s. Lankton grew up in Park Forest, IL, where she graduated a year early from high school to attend the Art Institute of Chicago from 1975 to1978. That year she moved to New York City and received her BFA from Pratt Institute in 1981. By then Lankton had secured her reputation as a leading figure in the social ferment of NYC in the 1980s through her visceral doll sculpture, and now lesser-known performances and minimalist soft sculpture.Lankton’s drawings are frequently compared to that of the expressionist Egon Schiele and her dolls and their photographic portraits, to that of surrealist Hans Bellmer. Yet her experimental and multimedia work are located within a history of transfeminism, avant-garde performance and even pop-art, while at the same time is equally situated within a neo-punk canon and the Trash Trilogy of John Waters films - Pink Flamingos being her favorite.Lankton’s exhibitions and performances included those at PS1, Club 57, Pyramid Club, Franklyn Furnace, Civilian Warfare Gallery, Hal Bromm and the Whitney Biennale, NYC. She also exhibited across the US and Europe, including the UK, Austria and the Venice Biennale, Italy. She exhibited her first full-scale installation artwork at the Mattress Factory Museum shortly before her untimely death in 1996. About the monograph Could It Be LoveEdited by Nan Goldin, Francis Schichtel, and Jordan Weitzman, the book draws deeply from the Greer Lankton Archive, housed at Mattress Factory, to present over 100 of Lankton’s rarely seen photographs. These images offer an intimate and theatrical glimpse into Lankton’s inner world, one populated by glamorous oddballs, downtown legends, and avatars of her own making.This exhibition is made possible by Teiger Foundation.

events.title: Birding Expedition: Blue Spruce County Park
events.description: Sat., November 14 | 8:30 - 11:30 amMembers: $50; Non-Members: $55 Meet Blue Spruce County Park Make your own magical woodland moment come to life with a trip to Blue Spruce County Park. Meet up with National Aviary Educator and Photographer Mike Faix and Ornithologist Robert Mulvihill for a morning of birdwatching...and chickadee feeding! Birders and animal-lovers will be able to hone bird identification skills, while younger families with birding beginners can learn the basics as you explore one of Western Pennsylvania’s most beautiful locations.Join us for this very special Indiana County birding experience, where adorable chickadees have been taught to land on the outstretched fingertips of bird watchers of all ages for scrumptious sunflower seeds! Having birds land on your hand for a seasonal snack is a very special and memorable experience for ALL ages that you don’t want to miss! Of course, November is near the height of fall bird migration, so Bob and Mike will also lead you on a park exploration in search of waterfowl and other traveling species. Both experts are experienced birding and education expert who will be able to provide interesting information and birding tales appealing to kids and adults alike. Birding Expeditions are open to participants 6 years and older. Those under 18 must be accompanied by a registered adult. Bring your own binoculars, or borrow an Aviary pair that we'll help you use!

Dinner, chocolates, and cocktails will all be located in the Overholt Room, the lower level of the Museum.VIP Admissions also receive an early VIP hour from 5 - 6 p.m., which includes an exclusive Overholt™ personalized limited release sampling with one of three educators available only during the VIP hour in the Stateroom. Additionally, VIPs can enjoy a VIP Curated Cocktail during the VIP hour along with the Whiskey Smash Cocktail downstairs in the Overholt Room. Explore the James B. Beam Pennsylvania Whiskey Heritage Center, a fully renovated and redesigned floor of our Museum that honors the past, present and future of Pennsylvania whiskey. Browse the largest publicly accessible collection of Pennsylvania whiskey artifacts in the Sam Komlenic Gallery, which includes 270+ historic whiskey bottles.Enjoy samples of Overholt™ in the Overholt Stateroom, the vintage-inspired lounge that pays homage to the origins of Overholt™ whiskey at West Overton. Overholt™ is recognized by whiskey historians as the longest standing American whiskey brand with an unbroken chain of ownership, production and sale since Abraham Overholt began distilling at West Overton in 1810. While the brand is produced today by James B. Beam Distilling Co. in Clermont, Kentucky, West Overton is proud to be the “spiritual home” of Overholt™.The Whiskey Smash is a fundraiser benefiting the nonprofit mission of West Overton Village. Our historic site, museum, and educational distillery invite visitors to discover the heritage of whiskey production at West Overton and across Pennsylvania. Proceeds from the Whiskey Smash support efforts including educational programs and historic preservation.This event is for ages 21+ with valid ID only. All guests must present a valid ID at the door, regardless of age. Guests without a valid ID will not be able to enter and tickets will not be refunded. Get TicketsGet your tickets here! Overton Road, Scottdale, PA. Please note accessing the Heritage Center requires stairs as we fundraise for an elevator. Contact us to discuss accessibility concerns.

events.title: Pouya
events.description: Miami rapper Pouya is recognized for helping popularize the dark, aggressive style often called “shadow rap” and for his independent role in the SoundCloud-era underground hip-hop scene. His catalog includes the Billboard-charting debut album Underground Underdog, the collaboration “1000 Rounds” with Ghostemane, and the $outh $ide $uicide EP with $uicideboy$. Pouya also co-founded the Buffet Boys collective with longtime collaborator Fat Nick, connecting his solo work to Miami’s independent rap community.

events.title: Pittsburgh Ballet Theatre, Pointe in Time Gala
events.description: Pittsburgh Ballet Theatre (PBT)’s Pointe in Time fundraiser is a top 10 annual event that brings over 400 arts patrons together in support of PBT’s mainstage programming, arts education in schools and community centers, classes for individuals with disabilities, and funding for its Bridge Scholarship program. Scholarships cover all tuition costs (school year and summer) as well as associated costs (pointe shoes, leotards and tights) which can cost up to $70,000 per student.For 57 years, Pittsburgh Ballet Theatre has inspired our community and made it a more beautiful place – on the stage, in the studio and in our neighborhoods. Join us in celebrating PBT’s Season of Wonder!The evening includes a multi-course dining experience for guests as they enjoy exclusive world-premiere performances by PBT company artists and PBT School students. A silent and live auction, pointe shoe raffle, and dancing are all a part of the night’s festivities.We invite you to gather family, friends, colleagues and clients, and join us for an unforgettable night celebrating PBT’s world-class art and life-changing programs.

events.title: Zoltan Kaszas
events.description: Zoltan Kaszas is a stand-up comedian known for sharp observational humor, dry wit, and relatable stories drawn from everyday life and cultural experiences. His comedy often explores family dynamics, social awkwardness, relationships, and immigrant upbringing through a conversational style that feels both personal and approachable. Kaszas has built a strong following through viral stand-up clips, crowd-friendly performances, and an ability to turn ordinary situations into clever comedic material. With laid-back delivery and smart storytelling, Zoltan Kaszas has become a rising favorite in modern stand-up comedy.

events.title: Orpheus & Eurydice
events.description: After the death of his beloved Eurydice, Orpheus vows to plunge into the very depths of the Underworld itself to bring her back. Moved by Orpheus’s passion, Amore (Cupid) appears and agrees to aid him in the rescue of his wife so long as he does not look at her until they return to the land of the living again.With the help of the spirits of the Underworld, Orpheus finds Eurydice in Elysium. But as he guides her to the surface, he knows he cannot look back. Eurydice believes this means he does not love her, and she refuses to take another step until he looks her way. So he does… but this classic tale may not end the way you’ve seen before!Based on the same Greek myth that inspired the Broadway hit Hadestown, Christoph Willibald Gluck's original 1774 score is enhanced by Hector Berlioz’s 1859 re-arrangement, making this a story that has only been enriched over the centuries.NOVEMBER 14, 20, 22, 2026 These performances are sponsored in part by The Gailliot Fund.

events.title: Joshua Radin
events.description: Joshua Radin is an acclaimed singer-songwriter known for intimate acoustic folk, gentle melodies, and emotionally candid lyrics. His music first gained broad attention through “Winter,” later featured on Scrubs, and his catalog includes fan favorites such as “Closer,” “Today,” and “I’d Rather Be With You.” With more than a billion streams, over a million albums sold worldwide, and songs featured across film, television, and advertising, Radin has built a devoted international following. His latest creative chapter includes One Day Home, a reflective 2025 album exploring love, loss, memory, and the meaning of home.

events.title: Yaelokre - Keath Osk
events.description: Yaelokre is the musical storytelling project of Icelandic-Filipino singer-songwriter and multimedia artist Keath Ósk. Built around the illustrated, diary-turned-storybook world of “Meadowlark,” the project follows the Lark, a quartet of young minstrels, through folk-inspired songs and character-driven mythology. Yaelokre gained broad attention with “Harpy Hare,” followed by releases including “And the Hound,” “Hartebeest,” and the “Composing Colentine” EP. Ósk’s work combines songwriting, illustration, and fairytale world-building into a distinctive contemporary folk presentation.

events.title: The Menzingers with Hot Water Music and Weakened Friends
events.description: The Menzingers are a punk rock band known for emotionally driven songwriting, anthemic choruses, and a sound that blends punk energy with heartland rock and Americana influences. Their music often explores nostalgia, aging, friendship, heartbreak, and everyday struggles through relatable storytelling and melodic guitar-driven arrangements. events.title: THE OLD ALLEGHENY COUNTY JAIL AND MUSEUM-FREE
events.description: Open on the 1st and 3rd Mondays of the month except on Court holidays.Visit at your convenience between 11:30 am and 1:00 pm--Cost: FREEPHLF docents are on hand to tell you the story of the former Allegheny County Jail. Completed in 1886 to the designs of Boston architect H.H. Richardson, it closed on July 27, 1995. The building was then renovated between 1995 and 2001 and adapted for a new use as the Family Division of the Allegheny County Court of Common Pleas. Working with the leadership of Allegheny County and with funding from the Drue Heinz Trust, our organization coordinated with the former jail's Deputy Warden Ed Urban and the Allegheny County Juvenile Court to preserve one portion of the cell blocks of the historic jail to create the Old Allegheny County Jail Museum. The Jail Museum, located in Downtown--at 440 Ross Street, Pittsburgh, PA 15219--opened in 2005.To access the Museum: Enter the Family Court Building through the main entrance on Ross Street. You will then be processed through a security checkpoint. The Museum is located across from the vending machine room. The use of cameras is NOT permitted.

events.description: Clown Boss Chad Damiani live directs a group of comics through their very first clown show. Along the way, he ruthlessly teases, cajoles and drives them to abandon their intellect and follow their dumbest impulses. A glorious celebration of failure and the cruelest show in clown, CHAD is BACK at Bottlerocket for another one-of-a-kind show you won't want to miss. Why'd We Book It? Clowning has sweeped the comedy world. Ask anyone who knows and they'll tell you who the real American CLOWN BOSS is - CHAD DAMIANI! Here's an opportunity to see the peak of a newly hot artform - and perhaps it's best teacher instructing LIVE ON STAGE (and being funny, don't worry) Extended Bio: CLOWN BOSS Chad Damiani is one of the architects of LA’s modern clown scene. He’s the creator/star of the STAND UP AND CLOWN podcast and live show – where he directs comics through their first clown performance. He’s an ensemble member for the international clown variety show STAMPTOWN (which just secured a Netflix comedy special for 2026). He has made numerous appearances on TV and film – including AGT, DAVE and TBS’s recent reboot of JO SCHMO. Chad works as a clown consultant for various artists and organizations – including Spiegelworld, Natalie Palamides and Piff the Magic Dragon. events.title: WYEP Presents: Aaron Lee Tasjan w/ Madeleine Kelson
events.description: WYEP PRESENTS: https://wyep.org/Doors 7PM | Show 8PM$25 ADV | $30 DOS21+Aaron Lee Tasjan was experiencing the worst bout of imposter syndrome of his career when he sat down and wrote Todd Snider a vulnerable email asking for advice. Tasjan, despite writing and recording some of the most astute Americana rock songs of the last decade and being nominated for a Grammy, just didnt see a future for an independent singer, songwriter, and guitarist like himself.Snider read Tasjans email and immediately replied: I think I have some ideas. Ill write you back tomorrow.The next morning, Tasjan awoke to a signature Todd Snider missive for how to move forward as an artist. It was a novel-length email that read like the battle plans for the Invasion of Normandy. Do this, Snider wrote. Then this. But never that. The specifics dont matter besides, thatd be giving away the secret but Tasjan devoured his mentors words and took them to heart.He began writing feverishly, unbothered by expectations and immune to any pressure to match his acclaimed albums like In the Blazes, Karma for Cheap, or his most recent, 2024s Stellar Evolution. When he was through, Tasjan had Get Over It, Underdog, his most inspiring LP to date. Produced by Tasjan and his longtime sound engineer Mark Miller, the album is a celebration of the power of songwriting, the unbreakable bond of friendship, and the determination of the dark horse.I went to the ultimate oasis for a singer, songwriter, and troubadour: Todd Snider. And he said, in very Todd fashion, You can find your path forward by going backwards, Tasjan says with a laugh. But he was right. I set aside my ego, played shows solo without my band, and wrote a lot of songs. In that process, I found my confidence again.Tragically, however, he lost his mentor. Snider died shortly after Get Over It, Underdog, was finished, leaving a void in the folk-rock scene that will prove nearly impossible to fill. But Tasjan is committed to carrying on Sniders unbridled spirit and lifting up underdogs everywhere.Over 11 tracks, Tasjans new album kills sacred cows and pokes holes in the dam, while leaning hard into the idea of perseverance. In the talking-blues of Science Friction, he tells an abridged origin story of civilization that culminates with humankind editing itself out of its own picture. Man made machines/putting man out of business, he sings witha knowing wink. Lost meanwhile, finds him feeling like a stranger in this town. Its a compact blast of indie-rock with a sing-along chorus that underscores Tasjans gift for writing infectious hooks.

events.title: Woodworking 101 with David Bielewicz
events.description: Learn the basics of wood shop machines, processes, and safety in this introductory course! 3-Hour Workshop Date: Wednesday, November 18, 2026 Time: 6pm-9pm Description: This designed-for-beginners course will explore the basics of woodworking in a judgement-free environment! Using the core machines of the wood studio, students will learn the lumber milling process—turning a rough-sawn board into dimensional lumber—which is the launching pad for nearly every wood project. Folks will build familiarity with the studio space, tools, and safety considerations and will walk away with several sample pieces demonstrating knowledge and confidence in the woodshop. If you’re hesitant to jump into one of our project-based workshops or curious if woodworking is even right for you, this is a great place to start! Tuition: $80 + $20 materials fee Materials: All materials will be provided. Location: Contemporary Craft Timmons Studios (5688 Butler St., Pittsburgh, PA 15201) Cancellations and Refunds: Workshop cancellations are decided three business days before the start date. If workshops must be cancelled due to insufficient enrollment, the entire class fee will be refunded by check, to your credit card, or Contemporary Craft account for future workshops. Refund Policy: Student refund requests must be made at least three business days before a class begins. There will be a $25 cancellation fee. events.description: Beartooth is a powerhouse hard rock and metalcore band founded by vocalist, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist Caleb Shomo, whose intensely personal approach to music has helped the group build a devoted international following. Together, these four bands deliver a diverse and high-energy concert experience that highlights the evolving landscape of modern rock and heavy music while offering something unique for fans across multiple genres.

events.description: BENNY FELDMAN is a stand-up comedian known for his one-liners about butterflies, frogs, and such, and for performing with Tourette’s syndrome. Feldman was named one of the New Faces at the 2022 Just For Laughs Festival in Montreal, performed on Comedy Central as part of their 2023 Stand-Up Featuring series, and performed at the Netflix is a Joke Festival in 2024. Feldman’s debut stand-up special, Butterfly Pavilion, is set to be released in early September of 2026. Why'd We Book It? Benny Feldman is one of a kind, bringing some of the most out of pocket one liners you will ever hear. There is no reason someone should drink liquid nightmares, but Benny thought it up for us all to ponder. One thing is for sure, you will leave this show pondering how one could come up with so many sentences that have never been said before. For Fans Of... events.title: Goose
events.description: Goose is an American jam band known for its vibrant improvisation, polished musicianship, and ability to blend rock, funk, folk, electronic, and indie influences into expansive live performances. Formed in Connecticut, the group built a passionate following through constant touring, word-of-mouth buzz, and fan-shared recordings that showcased the unpredictability and energy of its concerts. Their songs often begin with memorable melodies and tight arrangements before opening into adventurous instrumental passages that make each performance feel distinct from the last. Albums such as Dripfield and Everything Must Go have helped introduce Goose to a wider audience while preserving the exploratory spirit that first drew fans to the band. With a reputation for marathon sets, dynamic stage chemistry, and a steadily growing national presence, Goose has become one of the most talked-about acts in the modern jam-band scene.

events.title: Lenny Pearce
events.description: Lenny Pearce is an Australian DJ, producer, and entertainer who has gained international attention for creating family-friendly electronic music experiences that introduce younger audiences to the excitement of live dance music. A former member of the popular dance group Justice Crew, Pearce has successfully reinvented himself by combining high-energy DJ performances with interactive elements designed specifically for children and families. His shows feature upbeat remixes of familiar songs, colorful visuals, engaging activities, and an atmosphere that encourages participation from audiences of all ages. Through social media and live events, he has built a dedicated following by demonstrating that electronic music can be both accessible and entertaining for younger listeners while maintaining the excitement and production value associated with major dance performances. With his innovative approach to family entertainment and commitment to creating positive shared experiences, Lenny Pearce continues to carve out a unique niche within the global electronic music scene.

events.title: Intro to Blacksmithing: Campfire Forks with Eleanor Davidson
events.description: Learn how to forge your very own campfire fork! 3-Hour Workshop Date: Thursday, November 19th Time: 6pm- 9pm Description: Participants will learn basic blacksmithing techniques including chiseling, tapering, flattening, and twisting to create a 20″ long camping fork, great for roasting hot dogs or marshmallows over a fire. Beginner friendly and open to all skill levels! This class will involve hot metal, fire, and repetitive swinging of a hammer, it will be somewhat physically demanding so slight stamina is required. You’ll leave this class with a finished campfire fork of your very own! Tuition: $80+ $30 materials fee Materials: All materials will be provided. Students should wear natural fibers such as cotton and denim. Uncuffed pants and closed-toe shoes are required (no shorts or sandals permitted). Long hair should be restrained. Safety glasses and hearing protection are provided; however, participants may bring their own if preferred. We recommend bringing a water bottle to stay hydrated. This workshop is in an open air studio, bring a coat to keep warm before the forges get fired up! Location: Contemporary Craft – Timmons Studios, Blacksmithing Studio (5688 Butler St., Pittsburgh, PA 15201) Cancellations and Refunds: Workshop cancellations are decided three business days before the start date. If workshops must be cancelled due to insufficient enrollment, the entire class fee will be refunded through Eventbrite, or you may leave your workshop fee in your Contemporary Craft account for future workshops. Refund Policy: Student refund requests must be made at least three business days before a class begins. There will be a $25 cancellation fee. We are unable to refund materials cost for this workshop. No refunds will be given without three-business days notice. Processing of refunds takes approximately three weeks. About the Artist Eleanor Davidson is an artist, fabricator, and educator hailing from Kentucky and currently based in Pittsburgh, PA. Her work honors traditional craft techniques and industrial processes, primarily through metal casting, blacksmithing, and quilting. Prior to landing in Pittsburgh, Davidson was a longtime beginner blacksmithing instructor with the Kentucky Forge Council and Appalachian Area Chapter of Blacksmiths, and a featured demonstrator with the Kentucky Folklife Program. She holds a BFA in Sculpture from Western Kentucky University.

events.description: Goldfinger brings its energetic blend of punk rock, ska, and pop sensibility to the stage. Formed in Los Angeles in 1994, the band helped define the U.S. ska-punk revival alongside acts such as Rancid, No Doubt, Sublime, and The Mighty Mighty Bosstones. Known for high-impact performances and enduring fan favorites, Goldfinger delivers a lively concert experience filled with driving guitars, upbeat rhythms, and singalong-ready hooks. The group’s music continues to connect with both longtime alternative-rock fans and newer audiences discovering the genre’s irreverent, celebratory spirit.

events.title: Hannah Wicklund
events.description: Doors 7PM | Show 8PM $20 ADV | $25 DOS 21+ Hannah Wicklund is a South-Carolina-born rock musician who has spent more than two decades connecting people over her raw vocal power, world class guitar playing and awe inspiring live performances. Blending the raw power of rock n' roll, soul and psychedelic, Wicklund creates music for those seeking authenticity, human connection and creative freedom in an increasingly disconnected world. Her career began as a child performing with her band on the beaches of Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. After an early graduation from High School, she hit the road and hasn't looked back since performing in over 20 countries from intimate clubs to some of the world's biggest stages. Over the years, Wicklund has earned praise from Rolling Stone, Guitar World and Billboard. Her commanding live performances, musicianship and fiercely independent creative vision have helped build a devoted audience spanning generations and walks of life. Now, Hannah enters her most ambitious chapter yet with her fourth studio album, War on Women; Calling All Good Men (Out 8/28/26). Across 13 tracks, she moves fearlessly through rock, soul, blues, folk, gospel, psychedilia and pop, creating a record that can be both beauty and beast. Born from her experiences navigating power, betrayal, love and the expectations placed upon women to make themselves smaller, the album is deeply personal and a call-to-arms for change, and a tale of heartbreak in strange circumstances. Laying bare the obstacles Hannah overcame to take back control of her career, and offers hope for the future.

events.title: Cosmic Microwave Background
events.description:
Cosmic Microwave Background by Julia Fraser is a full-length play that shakes the anxieties of the digital age. Rita, a translator of Italian poetry, and her husband leave New York for remote calm in the desert. But after they arrive, only she hears a snaking sound that envelops the landscape and punctures her fresh start. When her tech-optimist neighbor echoes her interest in what she hears, they set off to uncover the noise before it explodes her sanity. It propels her on a quest to find its elusive source and recover her stability. How’s your hearing?

events.title: Cosmic Microwave Background
events.description:
Cosmic Microwave Background by Julia Fraser is a full-length play that shakes the anxieties of the digital age. Rita, a translator of Italian poetry, and her husband leave New York for remote calm in the desert. But after they arrive, only she hears a snaking sound that envelops the landscape and punctures her fresh start. When her tech-optimist neighbor echoes her interest in what she hears, they set off to uncover the noise before it explodes her sanity. It propels her on a quest to find its elusive source and recover her stability. How’s your hearing?

•	Dates: November 19-20 at 7:30 PM | November 20 at 10 am
•	Tickets: General Adult - $37 | Student - $27 |  Artist - $27
•	Purchase: https://ci.ovationtix.com/36406/production/1290278

events.title: Motionless In White with Dayseeker, The Devil Wears Prada and Dark Divine
events.description: Motionless In White is a metalcore band known for combining crushing heaviness, gothic imagery, industrial influences, and cinematic songwriting into a distinctive modern metal sound. Fronted by Chris Motionless, the band explores themes of individuality, resilience, horror aesthetics, and self-empowerment through powerful vocals and dramatic arrangements. Their music seamlessly blends aggressive breakdowns, electronic elements, and memorable choruses, helping them become one of the most recognizable acts in contemporary heavy music. Known for visually striking live performances and an unwavering connection with fans, Motionless In White continues to push the boundaries of modern metal.Dayseeker is a post-hardcore and alternative rock band celebrated for emotionally charged songwriting, atmospheric soundscapes, and the soulful vocals of Rory Rodriguez. Their music balances vulnerability and intensity, exploring themes of love, grief, mental health, healing, and personal transformation. Blending melodic rock, ambient textures, and modern production, Dayseeker has developed a sound that resonates deeply with listeners seeking both emotional depth and musical sophistication. Their captivating live performances have helped establish them as one of the most respected bands in the modern alternative scene.The Devil Wears Prada is a metalcore band known for its relentless energy, technical musicianship, and willingness to evolve beyond traditional genre boundaries. Their music combines aggressive riffs, dynamic vocal interplay, and thought-provoking lyrics that often explore personal struggles, perseverance, and human emotion. Over the years, the band has incorporated elements of post-hardcore, progressive metal, and atmospheric rock while maintaining the intensity that first earned them acclaim. Renowned for powerful live shows and a consistently innovative approach, The Devil Wears Prada remains a major force in heavy music.Dark Divine is a modern rock and metal band recognized for blending dark theatrical aesthetics with melodic metalcore and alternative metal influences. Their music features dramatic atmospheres, heavy instrumentation, and emotionally driven lyrics that explore themes of inner conflict, identity, heartbreak, and self-discovery. Combining haunting melodies with explosive energy, the band creates a sound that appeals to fans of both modern metal and gothic-inspired rock. Known for captivating performances and a strong visual identity, Dark Divine continues to gain attention as an emerging presence in the contemporary heavy music scene.

events.title: Andrea Gibson
events.description: Andrea Gibson was an acclaimed spoken-word poet, writer, and activist whose candid work explored love, identity, mental health, LGBTQ+ experiences, and social justice. Their artistry lives on in *Love Letter from the Afterlife*, a multimedia presentation built around Gibson’s final filmed live performance. The experience combines film, live poetry, music, orchestral accompaniment, and intimate storytelling, with Megan Falley sharing personal reflections on Gibson’s life and creative legacy. It offers audiences a moving, immersive celebration of a singular voice whose poetry transformed the modern spoken-word experience.

events.title: Zack Fox - DJ (18 and Over)
events.description: Zack Fox is a comedian, rapper, writer, actor, and internet personality whose unpredictable humor and fearless creativity have made him one of the most distinctive entertainers of his generation. First gaining widespread attention through his viral social media presence and sharp comedic commentary, Fox has successfully expanded into stand-up comedy, music, television, and voice acting while cultivating a devoted fan base. His stand-up performances blend surreal observations, improvisation, pop culture references, and personal stories into a fast-paced, anything-can-happen experience that keeps audiences constantly surprised. In addition to comedy, Fox has earned recognition for his music and creative collaborations, showcasing a versatility that allows him to move effortlessly between different forms of entertainment without losing his unmistakable comedic voice. Whether performing onstage, recording music, or creating digital content, Zack Fox delivers an energetic, unconventional, and thoroughly original performance that reflects his unique perspective and boundless imagination.

events.title: Introduction to Improv Embroidery with Alison Stein
events.description: Create an improvisational embroidery piece, taking a "doodle approach" to stitches! 3-Hour Workshop Date: Saturday, November 21 Time: 2 – 5 pm Description: This workshop will provide gentle encouragement and instruction on how to create beautiful embroidery pieces using an unplanned, improvisational approach. Whether you have never picked up a needle or are an experienced embroiderer, this method is available to you. Enjoy the beauty of color, textile and fiber without any stress of “messing up,” which is simply impossible in this approach! Techniques and Skills covered in this class will include: Learning (or unlearning) the mindset of embroidery without a pattern. Sourcing, selecting and preparing fabric and fiber for improv embroidery. Taking a “doodle approach” to embroidery stitches. We will take a different approach to learning or re-learning the basic embroidery stitches, encouraging beginners to feel confident, and more advanced students will have a new way of thinking about and building on stitches they already know. Thinking about color choices and composition Methods for addressing results you don’t love. Tuition: $65 + $15 materials fee Note: We really want you to join us in the studio! Full and partial tuition scholarships are available-with some limitations- to offset some of the financial burden of attending a class. Fill out the scholarship application here , and you can expect to hear from someone on the CC staff within 2 weeks. If you have any questions, email Jamie Boyle, Fibers Program Manager, at jboyle@contemporarycraft.org, or leave a voice message for them at 412-465-1628. Materials: All materials will be provided, however, participants are encouraged to bring any tools that they need to aid in seeing up-close: reading glasses, magnifyers, etc… Location: Contemporary Craft, Timmons Studios (5688 Butler St., Pittsburgh, PA 15201). Note, this workshop will take place in the Fleischner Family Fibers Loft, which is on the second floor of the building. There are 2 entrances to the Timmons Studios. • One entrance is facing Butler Street. To access the Fibers Loft from the Butler Street facing entrance, there are a total of 32 stairs to ascend. • One entrance is facing 57th Street. This entrance is accessible by ramp, with no stairs to ascend. There is a lift inside the building to access the second floor. If there are accessibility accommodations we can provide, or if there is anything you would like us to know before you arrive, please feel free to call Jamie Boyle at 412-465-1628 or email jboyle@contemporarycraft.org. If workshops must be cancelled due to insufficient enrollment, the entire class fee will be refunded through Eventbrite, or you may leave your workshop fee in your Contemporary Craft account for future workshops. Refund Policy: Student refund requests must be made at least three business days before a class begins. There will be a $25 cancellation fee. No refunds will be given without three-business days notice. Processing of refunds takes approximately three weeks. About the Artist Alison J. Stein is an artist, teacher and writer based in Carnegie, PA, in the Pittsburgh metro area. She makes vibrant textile art, paintings, prints and book art, and enjoys blurring the boundaries between traditional techniques and contemporary art.

events.title: WYEP Presents: Charlie Parr
events.description: WYEP Presents:https://wyep.org/Sat Nov 21st Doors 7PM | Show 8PM$25 ADV | $30 DOS21+ Rolling Stone has called Charlie Parrs music a gritty blend of Delta blues and Depression-era roots music soaked in his hardscrabble voice. Its a sacred realm of folk wisdom and sorrowful vulnerability. NPR said he offers expertly-picked resonator guitar and lyrics that puncture the soul. Parr tours prolifically, and has performed at tastemaker events like the Newport Folk Fest and Pickathon.The Duluth-based guitarist, songwriter, and interpreter of traditional music has released twenty albums over two-and-a-half decades and has been known to perform up to 275 shows a year. Parr is a folk troubadour in the truest sense: taking to the road between shows, writing and rewriting songs as he plays, fueled by a belief that music is eternal and cannot be claimed or adequately explained. The sounds from his working-class upbringingincluding Folkways legends such as Lead Belly and Woody Guthrieimbue Parrs music with stylistic echoes of blues and folk icons of decades past. Parr sees himself merely as a continuer of a folk tradition.Parrs mastery of his craft is only more apparent when contextualized within the history of folk tradition to which Parr has dedicated his practice. The land and lives around and intersecting with Parr have always influenced him, from the hills and valleys of Hollandale, Minnesota to the Depression-era stories from his father.Parrs first album with Smithsonian Folkways, Last of the Better Days Ahead (2021), foregrounded his lyrical craftsmanship and sophisticated bluesman confidence, with spare production highlighting Parrs mastery of guitar and elevating his blues poetry. In his 2024 release, Little Sun, Parr weaved together stories celebrating music, community, and communing with nature. In doing so, he put forth an ambitious and raw album that exemplifies the best of Parrs sound: his blend of the blues and folk traditions with the steadfast originality of a poet. Now, he continues that tradition with 2026s poignant and timely Rooming House, which joins the chorus of WPA-era socially-conscious folk operas and outlaw country concept albums of the 1970s to poignantly allegorize his experiences and the experiences of the people around him.

events.title: How The Grinch Stole Christmas - The Musical
events.description: How the Grinch Stole Christmas! The Musical brings Dr. Seuss’s beloved holiday story to the stage with colorful costumes, whimsical sets, and festive musical numbers. The production follows the grumpy Grinch as he attempts to stop Christmas in Whoville, only to discover the true meaning of the holiday through unexpected kindness and community spirit. Featuring classic songs alongside lively choreography and imaginative storytelling, the show captures the playful charm and heartwarming message of the original tale. With family-friendly humor and vibrant theatrical spectacle, How the Grinch Stole Christmas! The Musical has become a popular holiday tradition for audiences of all ages.

events.title: Cassadee Pope
events.description: Cassadee Pope is a singer-songwriter recognized for bridging pop-punk, country and rock. She first gained attention as the lead vocalist of Hey Monday before becoming the first woman to win NBC’s The Voice in 2012. Her solo debut, Frame by Frame, opened at No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Country Albums chart and features the hit single “Wasting All These Tears.” Pope also earned a No. 1 country airplay hit with Chris Young on “Think of You.” Her later releases, including Stages and Thrive, reflect her continuing movement between country-pop and her pop-punk roots.

events.title: Holiday Lights Walking Tour
events.description: Our holiday tour! Get into the holiday spirit and enjoy an evening in Downtown Pittsburgh, learning about the history of the city, discovering beautiful squares and pieces of architecture, while getting to see all the festive holiday lights and decorations. Walk past many different and gorgeous Christmas trees, a unique gingerbread house display, a replica of the crèche from Vatican City, the central holiday market, and much more! The grand finale of the tour will be a very fun ice skating rink and Santas from all around the world!​PRICE: Adults $29, Children $16 (age 6-13)​INCLUDED: a local expert guide, great holiday lights, a lot of fun, coupons from our restaurant partners​TOUR TIMES: almost daily at 5 p.m. during the holiday seasonDURATION: 2 hours WALKING DISTANCE: approx. 2 miles of walking​​TOUR START: 1049 Penn Ave, Downtown Pittsburgh (Convention Center)TOUR END: Holiday Market on Market Square (15 min walk from the starting point)

events.title: Catch Your Breath
events.description: Catch Your Breath is an Austin-based alt-rock band known for combining heavy riffs, melodic guitar work, synth-driven soundscapes, and emotionally charged vocals. Their energetic live performances and anthemic songwriting have helped build a strong following across the modern rock and metal community. The band’s music often explores mental health, self-reflection, personal growth, and resilience, creating a powerful connection with audiences. Catch Your Breath recently released its sophomore album, Not Broken Enough, through Thriller Records, adding new momentum to the group’s evolving sound and making this a compelling concert experience for fans of emotionally intense hard rock.

events.title: The Clarks (21+ Event)
events.description: The Clarks are a Pittsburgh-rooted rock band formed in 1986, known for blending roots-rock twang, power-pop energy and relatable songwriting. Their regional breakthrough came with “Help Me Out,” while “Let It Go” and “Better Off Without You” became enduring fan favorites. The band has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman and had music featured in The Simpsons and The Pitt. With 11 studio albums and a four-decade history, The Clarks remain one of Western Pennsylvania’s most recognizable hometown bands.

events.title: SkyWatch Junior: Growing up with Stars
events.description: Explore the life cycle of stars and how they age with Quasi! Create your own constellation using markers, stickers, and gemstones, play with magnifying glasses to identify different objects, and explore filters and how they capture different energies of light in space. Enjoy an iconic planetarium show and stargaze from our observatory deck (weather-permitting). Viewing targets include Orion Nebula, a stellar nursery in constellation Orion, Pleiades an open star cluster located about 440 light-years away in the constellation Taurus, the Moon, and Saturn.

events.title: Jim Brickman
events.description: Jim Brickman is a pianist, composer, and songwriter known for his soothing contemporary instrumental music and romantic piano melodies. His performances blend classical influences with pop and adult contemporary styles, creating elegant compositions that are widely associated with relaxation, romance, and emotional reflection. Brickman has collaborated with numerous vocalists throughout his career, producing heartfelt songs and seasonal favorites that have earned him a devoted audience across generations. With graceful piano work, warm stage presence, and decades of successful touring and recordings, Jim Brickman remains one of the most recognizable artists in contemporary instrumental music.

events.title: Christopher Williams
events.description: Christopher Williams is an acclaimed R&B vocalist whose smooth, expressive style helped define the sound of late-1980s and 1990s urban soul. He is best known for the charting favorites “I’m Dreamin’,” featured on the New Jack City soundtrack, and “Every Little Thing U Do,” showcasing his polished delivery and romantic songwriting. Audiences can expect an engaging live performance that celebrates his enduring catalog, soulful vocals, and distinctive place in contemporary R&B history. This appearance offers longtime fans and newcomers an opportunity to experience a celebrated voice from one of the genre’s most memorable eras.

events.title: And A Buoy
events.description: And a Buoy by Eli Plummer is a staged reading about a father, a son, and a bond buoyed through the changing tides of time. Set entirely on a cuddy boat off the coast of Maine, the story anchors Sean and his son, Aaron, during their annual fishing trips. As the scenes jump from the early 2000s into the mid-2030s, the audience watches Aaron grow up, and Sean grow older. Exploring the complexities of fatherhood, the piece reveals how their connection holds strong as they navigate what love is supposed to look like—and the quiet ways it shows up.

events.title: Next Steps: Sewing: Zip ID Wristlet with Alli Murray
events.description: Level up your sewing skills, and learn to make your own Zip ID Wristlet—which makes a super sweet gift— in this two-day workshop! Two-Day Workshop! Date: Tuesday Evenings: December 1 and 8 Time: 6pm-9pm Description: Used a sewing machine before? Sewn a basic seam? Then, you are ready to join Alli to level up, practice your sewing skills, and have a great time while making a super cute accessory that makes a super cute gift in this next steps: sewing workshop! Learn to make your own Zip ID Wristlet! This handy pouch can store your ID, essential cards, and other small must-haves. Easy to take on-the-go by itself or to throw in your bag. The wristlet includes a hinge ring to attach your keys. Use them together, or separate. The Zip ID wristlet combines convenience with style, and it makes a super sweet gift! During this course you will learn: How to attach zippers How to make custom bias binding *Please note: Basic sewing skills, including sewing machine operation, required, this class will not go over how to use a sewing machine. This workshop is part of the Contemproary Craft studios’ Gift Guide suite of workshops! Join us in the studio, learn a skill, make a gift! Refund Policy: Student refund requests must be made at least three business days before a class begins. There will be a $25 cancellation fee. events.title: Stephen Wilson Jr with Kashus Culpepper
events.description: Stephen Wilson Jr. with Kashus Culpepper brings together two rising artists known for emotionally driven songwriting and a fresh approach to modern Americana and country music. Stephen Wilson Jr. blends country, rock, folk, and alternative influences into a raw and deeply personal sound filled with introspective lyrics, gritty vocals, and powerful storytelling. His music often explores themes of identity, resilience, heartbreak, and personal growth through stripped-down authenticity and emotionally intense performances.Kashus Culpepper adds a soulful Southern sound rooted in country, blues, and Americana traditions, pairing heartfelt songwriting with rich vocals and organic instrumentation. His performances emphasize emotional honesty and roots-inspired musicianship that complements the raw energy of the headlining act. Together, the lineup creates a moving live music experience filled with heartfelt storytelling, Americana grit, and modern country soul.

A Daily Bread performance offers a dynamic meeting point between beat-driven energy, soulful sampling, and forward-thinking electronic production.

events.description: The Stray Cats are an American rockabilly trio formed by guitarist-vocalist Brian Setzer, bassist Lee Rocker and drummer Slim Jim Phantom. events.title: Species Spotlight: Penguins
events.description: Thurs., December 3 | 2 - 4 pm | 18+Members: $25; Non-Members: $30What tuxedoed bird is known for waddling and swimming...NOT flight? The National Aviary’s African Penguin colony is a favorite of visitors and staff alike. But did you know that this charming bird is a fierce aquatic predator...one who the Aviary works with in the wild as the species is at serious risk of extinction by the year 2035? During this in-depth class for adults, learn more about African Penguins and the conservation challenges they face. Learn from an Aviary expert who leads the Saving Animals from Extinction African Penguin program. They will share the threats to African Penguins and how we are part of a team, including people from North America, South Africa, and Namibia who are working together tirelessly to save them...while we still can.This program is designed specifically for an adult learner audience. Participants must be 18 years or older to participate.

events.title: Needle Felting: Bird of the Month: Northern Cardinal with Erin Carlson
events.description: December’s bird of the month: Northern Cardinal! Learn to needle felt, while enjoying a detailed look at this fascinating bird! 3-hour workshop Date: Thursday, December 3 Time: 6pm-9pm Description: Learn to needle felt or sharpen your skills while creating your own Northern Cardinal . Fiber artist and backyard bird enthusiast Erin Carlson of Red Cottage Fiber Studio will guide you through the needle felting process as you look closely to observe the shape and markings of the species and gain a deeper appreciation of our avian neighbors. Adventurous beginners welcome. Please note that we will be using sharp needles and repetitive, detailed hand motions. About the 2026-27 Bird of the Month Needle Felting Series : Due to popular demand, Contemporary Craft is thrilled to once again partner with instructor Erin Carlson to offer this series of workshops! While first offered virtually during the pandemic, this year will be live and in-person! Classes will occur the first Thursday of each month from 6-9pm and run from March 2026-February 2027. Join us for as many classes as you like. Choose your favorite bird or join us for all 12 to complete your very own flock. The bird selections are as follows: March: American Robin April: Scarlet Tanager May: Barn Swallow June: Eastern Bluebird July: Ruby-Throated Hummingbird August: American Goldfinch September: Downy Woodpecker October: Barn Owl November: Chickadee December: Northern Cardinal January(2027): Red Breasted Nuthatch February(2027): Red Winged Blackbird Tuition: $65 + $10 materials fee (per workshop) (if you are viewing this listing on your phone, scroll down to the bottom of the page for the class registration link) Materials: all materials are included. Note: We really want you to join us in the studio! Full and partial tuition scholarships are available to alleviate some of the financial burden of attending a class. Scholarship application is found at this link . You can expect to hear from someone on the CC staff within 2 weeks. If you have any questions, email Jamie Boyle, Fibers Program Manager, at jboyle@contemporarycraft.org, or leave a voice message for them at 412-465-1628. Location: Contemporary Craft, TImmons Studios (5688 Butler St., Pittsburgh, PA 15201). Note, this workshop will take place in the Fleischner Family Fibers Loft, which is on the second floor of the building. There are 2 entrances to the Timmons Studios. • One entrance is facing Butler Street. To access the Fibers Loft from the Butler Street facing entrance, there are a total of 32 stairs to ascend. • One entrance is facing 57th Street. This entrance is accessible by ramp, with no stairs to ascend. There is a lift inside the building to access the Fibers Loft on the second floor. If there are accessibility accommodations we can provide, or if there is anything you would like us to know before you arrive, please feel free to call Jamie Boyle at 412-465-1628 or email jboyle@contemporarycraft.org. About the Artist Erin Carlson is a multidiscplinary fiber artist working and teaching in th Pittsburgh area for the last decade. She loves to help students explore their creativity through the use of fibers.

events.title: Aiden Sinclair in Fate & Futility: A Show of Magick & Mysteries
events.description: Join Aiden Sinclair for an esoteric evening of supernatural magic as he explores the concepts of fate and destiny in an interactive 90-minute presentation of the strange.Audiences will enjoy a storied evening of ancient magical effects that include experiences with the Tarot, Rune Casting and Prognostication that will leave all to wonder if fate might be more than an idea, and that destiny may indeed be real.Aiden Sinclair has performed as the resident Magus of the Historic Stanley Hotel in Estes Park, Colorado for over a decade where he is the proprietor of Aiden Sinclair’s Magick Underground.He has appeared on America’s Got Talent and Penn & Teller: Fool Us and has served as a consultant on magic and the occult to numerous film and television productions.Since 2022, Aiden has also founded the 501c3 Humanitarian Aid Charity Organization Trident Aid, which provides critical medical supplies to the front lines of Ukraine. All of Aiden’s performance proceeds are donated to this organization and cause.

events.title: Pittsburgh Ballet Theatre w/ The Nutcracker
events.description: Unwrap the Magic!Terrence S. Orr’s beloved version of The Nutcracker returns for its final year at Pittsburgh Ballet Theatre, inviting Pittsburgh audiences to gather one last time around this treasured holiday tradition. The Nutcracker overflows with warmth, nostalgia and theatrical magic. As we prepare for an all-new production in 2027, this fond farewell honors a sparkling world that has lived in the city’s heart for more than twenty years.​Set in turn-of-the-century Pittsburgh, Orr’s The Nutcracker whisks audiences into an unforgettable adventure with Marie and the Nutcracker Prince as they journey through swirling snow and into the Land of Enchantment. There, they meet the Sugar Plum Fairy and hundreds of colorful characters, all brought to life with amazing dancing and the iconic Tchaikovsky score.Concept & Choreography: Terrence S. Orr I Music: P.I. Tchaikovsky

Masse, a member of the folk trio The Wailin’ Jennys, joins Dworsky, the longtime pianist and music director of the radio program, for a performance shaped by their shared history on air and onstage.

events.description: Drop into our metals studio and get hand on assistance making your very own Sterling Silver Ring! DROP IN STYLE: 3-hour session! Date: Saturday, December 5th Time: Start times vary: 10 AM, 12 PM, 2 PM (expect to stay for about 2-3 hours after your start time for your ring to reach completion!). You will select your start time when you register. Description: Jewelry making curious? This is your chance!!! Absolute beginner drop-in style metalsmithing has arrived! You’ll start by getting sized for your very own Sterling Silver ring, then instructor, Rachael Scott, and our metals coaches will walk you through bending wire into shape, soldering the ends together, and sanding your ring to completion!
